STATEMENT_LIMIT: Poora statement iss local download ke liye bahut bada hai. Business ledger export karo.
DEMO_ONLY: Sirf apni alag demo dukaan reset kar sakte ho. Asli ya shared business reset nahi honge.
UNIT_LOCKED: Stock change ke baad unit fixed hai. Dusri unit ke liye alag product banao.
QUANTITY_PRECISION: Yeh quantity exactly convert nahi ho sakti. Product unit mein decimal ke baad teen digits tak rakho.
INVALID_IMAGE: Sahi JPEG, PNG ya WebP photo chuno. Damaged, animated ya bahut badi image available nahi hai.
ATTACHMENT_LIMIT: Photo storage bhar gaya hai. Nayi photo se pehle unused photos hatao.
ATTACHMENT_LOCKED: Yeh photo saved bill ki hai. Badal ya dobara use nahi kar sakte.
DUPLICATE_ATTACHMENT: Har photo selected product ke saath ek hi baar jodo.
DUPLICATE_PAYMENT: Cash aur UPI ek-ek baar daalo. Split payment check karo.
PAYMENT_MISMATCH: Total mile paise cash aur UPI amounts ke barabar hone chahiye.
INVALID_INPUT: Darj details check karke phir try karo.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Darj details check karke phir try karo.
INVALID_QUANTITY: Chuni hui unit ke hisaab se sahi quantity daalo.
INVALID_AMOUNT: Sahi amount daalo aur decimal ke baad allowed digits hi rakho.
AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE: Yeh amount allowed limit se zyada hai. Chhota amount daalo.
FRACTIONAL_UNIT: Pieces, packets aur boxes ki quantity whole number mein rakho. Unit check karo.
INVALID_UNIT: Available piece, weight, volume ya length unit chuno.
INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Stock kam hai. Confirm karne se pehle available quantity check karo.
STOCK_LIMIT: Iss change se stock allowed range ke bahar hoga. Quantity check karo.
SKU_EXISTS: Iss business mein yeh SKU pehle se hai. Dusra SKU chuno.
DUPLICATE_ITEM: Purchase mein har product ek hi baar jodo.
INVALID_DISCOUNT: Discount bill subtotal se zyada nahi ho sakta.
OVERPAYMENT: Payment baaki amount se zyada nahi ho sakta. Save se pehle amount check karo.
CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: Udhaar ya partial payment wale bill ke liye customer chuno.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Yeh attempt alag details ke saath pehle save hua hai. Nayi entry se pehle records check karo.
REPAYMENT_EXISTS: Iss bill par baad mein payments mile hain. Cancel ke liye reviewed adjustment chahiye, jo abhi available nahi hai.
DAY_CLOSED: Yeh hisaab band hai. Agla len-den karne se pehle Aaj Ka Karobaar Shuru Karein mein shuruaati cash confirm karein.
ALREADY_CLOSED: Aaj ka hisaab pehle se save hai. Confirmed summary dekhne ke liye refresh karo.
NOT_FOUND: Chune hue business mein yeh record available nahi hai. Refresh karke phir try karo.
LIMIT_REACHED: Iss local workspace ki record limit poori ho gayi hai.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Session khatam ho gaya hai. Aage badhne ke liye dobara login karo.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email ya password sahi nahi hai.
EMAIL_EXISTS: Iss email se account pehle se hai. Ussi account mein login karo.
RATE_LIMITED: Bahut saare attempts hue hain. Thodi der baad phir try karo.
CSRF_REJECTED: DukaanSet ko ussi site par kholo, refresh karo aur phir try karo.
INVALID_CONTENT_TYPE: Entry padhi nahi gayi. Page refresh karke phir try karo.
BODY_TOO_LARGE: Yeh entry bahut badi hai. Kam items jodkar phir try karo.
INVALID_JSON: Entry padhi nahi gayi. Page refresh karke phir try karo.
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Yeh action available nahi hai. Refresh karke phir try karo.
CONFLICT: In details wala record pehle se hai. Existing record check karo.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Kaam poora nahi hua. Phir try karne se pehle records check karo.
OFFLINE: Internet nahi hai. Save se pehle connect karo.
UNKNOWN: Kaam poora nahi hua. Phir try karne se pehle records check karo.
EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Shop setup se pehle email par aaye single-use link se verify karo.
EMAIL_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: Email delivery available nahi hai. Setup check karo.
INVALID_TOKEN: Link missing, expired ya use ho chuka hai. Naya link maango.
FORBIDDEN: Aapka role yeh module nahi khol sakta.
FEATURE_DISABLED: Is shop ke liye yeh feature band hai
STALE_SETTINGS: Settings badal gayi. Refresh karke save karo.
VARIANT_MISMATCH: Same unit aur exact saved variant chuno. Dusre size ka stock yeh request poori nahi karega.
ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT: Matching confirmed invoice chuno. Units aur revenue ek hi baar link ho sakte hain.
INVALID_ATTRIBUTION: Matching confirmed invoice chuno. Units aur revenue ek hi baar link ho sakte hain.
INVALID_TRANSITION: Matching confirmed invoice chuno. Units aur revenue ek hi baar link ho sakte hain.
DEMAND_LINKED: Matching confirmed invoice chuno. Units aur revenue ek hi baar link ho sakte hain.
OWNER_REQUIRED: Yeh kaam owner hi kar sakta hai.
ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Member ka DukaanSet account hona chahiye aur private single-use invitation accept karna hoga.
MEMBER_EXISTS: Yeh member pehle se juda hai.
AI_UNAVAILABLE: AI service available nahi hai. Saved records ka summary dekh sakte hain.
INVOICE_CANCELLED: Cancelled bill demand ki sale nahi ban sakta.
CONTACT_EXISTS: In details ka contact pehle se hai. Uska account dekho.
CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: Is bill ke customer ko chuno.
PRODUCT_EXISTS: Yeh product pehle se hai. Catalogue se chuno.
DOCUMENT_COLOUR: Padhne layak text ke liye dark accent colour chunein.
DOCUMENT_RANGE: Aaj ya pehle khatam hone wali sahi date range chunein.
DOCUMENT_INCOMPLETE: Records adhoore hain. Document se pehle ledger check karein.
DOCUMENT_LIMIT: Document bahut bada hai. Chhoti avadhi chunein.
DOCUMENT_EXPIRED: PDF expire ho gaya. Nayi presentation copy banayein.
WHATSAPP_CONSENT: Transaction permission aur source save karein; customer ke mana karne ka dhyan rakhein.
WHATSAPP_CONFIRMATION: Share karne se pehle recipient confirm karein.
WHATSAPP_RECIPIENT: Pehle is customer ka sahi WhatsApp number save karein.
WHATSAPP_NOT_CONNECTED: Official WhatsApp sending connected nahi hai. Manual sharing karein.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE: Settings mein is bhasha ka approved document template check karein.
WHATSAPP_LANGUAGE: Pehle selected message bhasha mein PDF banayein.
WHATSAPP_PENDING: Pehle wale submission ka status check karein. Abhi doosri copy mat bhejein.
WHATSAPP_RATE_LIMIT: WhatsApp ne request limit ki. Ruk kar dobara check karein.
WHATSAPP_CREDENTIALS: Business sender ko administrator ki madad chahiye. Manual share kar sakte hain.
WHATSAPP_REJECTED: WhatsApp ne document request reject ki. Recipient aur connection check karein.
WHATSAPP_TIMEOUT: Provider ka response ruk gaya. Retry se pehle recorded status check karein.
STALE_PREVIEW: Review ke baad records badle hain. Naye total dekhkar dobara confirm karein.
CASH_COUNT_REQUIRED: Gine hue cash ki rakam bharein. Is dukaan mein cash ginna zaroori hai.
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED: Hisaab band karne se pehle antar ya baaki kaam dekhkar sahmati dein.
SESSION_ACTIVE: Ek hisaab session khula hai. Karobari samay badalne ya naya session kholne se pehle ise band karein.
INVALID_TIME: Session ka samay aur timezone dekhein. Naya session pichhle closing ke baad shuru hona chahiye.
ACCOUNTING_LIMIT: Hisaab ka total samarthit seema se zyada hai. Records export karke sahayata se sampark karein.
CORRECTION_SOURCE: Is hisaab ke band hone ke baad darj len-den chunein. Purane len-den surakshit total mein pehle se shaamil hain.
VOICE_AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE: Abhi speech available nahi hai. Draft safe hai; retry karein ya type karein.
VOICE_AUDIO_CONSENT: Speech service use karne se pehle assistant settings mein cloud speech allow karein.
VOICE_LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Yeh awaaz conversation ki bhasha nahi bol sakti. Compatible awaaz chunein ya type karein.
INVALID_VOICE_AUDIO: Mic ki chhoti aur supported recording use karein.
STALE_VOICE_PREFERENCE: Kisi aur session mein awaaz ki pasand badli hai. Refresh karke dobara chunein.
STALE_VOICE_DRAFT: Stock, rate ya customer details badli hain. Save se pehle naya draft check karein.
